# Municipal Ordinance No. 05, Series of 2019

**The CCTV Installation Ordinance of Pitogo, Quezon**

An Ordinance Requiring the Installation of Closed Circuit Television (CCTV) or Video Surveillance System (VSS) in All Business Establishments in [[Pitogo]], [[Quezon Province|Quezon]].

## Summary

Enacted on October 14, 2019, this ordinance mandates the installation of Closed Circuit Television (CCTV) or Video Surveillance System (VSS) in all business establishments within the [[Municipality of Pitogo]]. The measure was enacted pursuant to the general welfare clause under [[Sec-16-RA7160]] and references [[DILG]] Memorandum Circular No. 2012-38, which encourages local government units to utilize modern technology for crime detection and prevention. The ordinance recognizes that CCTV records serve as valuable tools in identifying perpetrators of crimes, accidents, and vandalism. Absent from the session were Vice Mayor [[Paul Timothy C. Villaflor]] (O.B.), [[Fidel M. Malapit]] (O.B.), and [[Karl Anthonie A. De Asis]] (O.B.).

## Key Provisions

- **Mandatory Installation.** All business establishments operating within [[Pitogo]] are required to install CCTV or VSS in their premises.
- **Coverage.** Applies to all business establishments regardless of size or nature of business.
- **Purpose.** CCTV systems shall serve as tools for crime detection and prevention, as well as for identifying perpetrators of crimes, accidents, and vandalism.
- **Reference to DILG MC 2012-38.** Implements the recommendation of the [[DILG]] encouraging LGUs to adopt modern technology for public safety and crime deterrence.
- **Short Title.** The ordinance shall be known as "The CCTV Installation Ordinance of Pitogo, Quezon."
- **Penalties.** Non-compliant establishments shall be subject to penalties as prescribed under the ordinance.
- **Effectivity.** Takes effect upon approval.
